name: currency-exchange-api
description: Public API that converts an amount in a given ISO 4217 source currency to USD using the current exchange rate. Validates a shared API key on every request, fetches the latest USD-based rates from the ExchangeRate-API provider, and returns clear errors for unsupported currencies or invalid amounts. Does not support batch conversion, historical rates, non-USD target currencies, or any web UI.

dependencies.name: exchange-rate-provider
dependencies.description: ExchangeRate-API — fetches the latest USD-based conversion rates (GET /v6/{API_KEY}/latest/USD) and picks the requested source currency's rate to convert an amount to USD.

config.description: API key for ExchangeRate-API, from https://app.exchangerate-api.com.
Base URL of the ExchangeRate-API v6 endpoint used to fetch current rates.
